objections.claim: Section 5(e)(iv)'s App-suspension mechanism does not establish the claimed exclusive interval or make a compromised App private key "platform-DEAD." The same private key can mint the App JWT required to call DELETE /app/installations/{id}/suspended and then mint a new installation access token, so its holder can self-unsuspend the controller or publisher and regain contents:write during or outside the publish ceremony. The proposed 403 regression tests only a suspended installation credential and does not test this self-unsuspension path. Either treat compromise of either App private key explicitly as a trust-root compromise and retract the stronger closed-writer/frozen-interval claims, or use an independent revocation boundary the App key cannot reverse and add the corresponding adversarial regression.
